instructions: Reserve friendly team names in the operator-selected local registry. Each successful call creates a new reservation; retrying is not idempotent. No model or network is used.

tools.description: Generate and reserve a unique friendly team name in the explicit local registry selected by the operator. Reservations persist across calls and process restarts. This writes a local reservation; do not automatically retry an uncertain call.
